sources.summary: This issue of Scientific Collection «InterConf» contains the materials of the International Scientific and Practical Conference. The conference provides an interdisciplinary forum for researchers, practitioners and scholars to present and discuss the most recent innovations and developments in modern science. The aim of conference is to enable academics, researchers, practitioners and college students to publish their research findings, ideas, developments, and innovations.

sources.title: Healthcare for Germline Genetically Modified People
sources.summary: Genome editing technologies, such as CRISPR/Cas9, are progressing rapidly. The birth of germline genetically edited individuals in China, the progression of somatic gene editing in clinical trials, the shift in expert stakeholders’ openness towards germline gene editing, and the inconsistent implementation of policies governing these technologies across jurisdictions, suggest more that a growing number of genetically edited humans will likely be born in the future.
